content: वीर [अजेः रक् वीभावश्च <ls>Uṇ. 2. 13</ls>] {%a.%} .²1 Heroic, brave. .²2 Mighty, powerful. .²3 Excellent, eminent. .{@-रः@} .²1 A hero, warrior, champion; कोऽप्येष संप्रति नवः पुरुषावतारो वीरो न यस्य भगवान् भृगुनन्दनोऽपि <ls>U. 5. 33</ls>. .²2 The sentiment of heroism (in rhetoric); अस्तोकवीरगुरुसाहसमद्भुतं च <ls>Mv. 1. 6</ls>; it is distinguished under four heads; दानवीर, धर्मवीर, दयावीर and युद्धवीर; (for explanation see these words <ab>s. v.</ab>). .²3 An actor. .²4 Fire. .²5 The sacrificial fire. .²6 A son; अस्य कुले वीरो जायते <ls>Ch. Up. 3. 13. 6</ls>; वीरं मे दत्त पितरः Śrāddhamantras. .²7 A husband. .²8 The Arjuna tree. .²9 A Jaina. .²10 The Karavīra tree. .²11 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .{@-रम्@} .²1 A reed. .²2 Pepper. .²3 Rice-gruel. .²4 The root of Uśīra <ab>q. v.</ab> .²5 Iron; <ls>Gīrvāṇa.</ls>
